title: Inside ZCode: Silently uploading your Git history to the cloud
summary: Security researcher exposes ZCode IDE extension's undisclosed behavior of silently uploading complete Git workspace snapshots and history to cloud servers without explicit user consent or notification.
problem_solved: Reveals undisclosed surveillance behavior in a developer tool that harvests user code repositories without transparency.
why_valuable: Highlights critical privacy violations in developer tooling, alerting users to hidden data collection practices that could expose proprietary code and credentials.
